scenes.narration: Town Hall 19 is finally here, and it changes how everyone attacks. Here's everything new in 60 seconds.
The biggest change is Squads: whole groups of troops you drop with a single tap, trained in the brand new Squad Barracks.
Squads unlock at Town Hall 8, with a new one every Town Hall, up to twelve at Town Hall 19. But only Town Hall 19 can level them up.
Your Town Hall becomes a weapon of your choice: a Barbarian, Archer or Wizard Hall that unleashes troops when it's attacked.
Defenses get two new towers, the Spiky Tower and the Firecracker Tower, and Guardians move into their own Guardian Shrine.
Heroes climb higher too. The Barbarian King now maxes out at level 115.
Plus new Magic Snacks, and a Star Bonus that now scales with your Town Hall level.
So, are you rushing to Town Hall 19, or staying where you are? Tell me in the comments.
